title: Kinda broken, but nice!
text: Kinda broken, but nice!. It was a little precarious to put a bunch of salt rocks on top of a bare bulb, but I've been using them constantly for months, and they've held up. The bigger one wasn't working at first. I think the wire is shorted, so it has to be at a certain angle to turn on, but I just pinched it into that position and it's fine.
